morbi.headline: Mixed week for Morbi: Tile export projections drop while propane availability lowers input costs
what_changed: Somany Ceramics projected total tile exports to decline to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore.
Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption following an improved supply of propane.
Apollo Pipes set a revenue target of Rs 1,000 crore for its ceramics business.
stress_signals: Overall tile exports projected to fall to Rs 12,000-13,000 crore [202e1481c238]
improvement_signals: Reduction in PNG consumption across ceramic units due to better propane supply availability [81469af468f3]
what_to_watch: Propane vs. PNG cost differentials and actual fuel substitution volumes in Morbi cluster.
Export order book trends and destination-specific demand slowdowns for tile exporters.
Apollo Pipes' market entry strategy and potential manufacturing partnerships or capacity setups.

surat.headline: Mixed week in Surat with input cost relief, operational restarts, and stricter printing payment terms.
what_changed: Textile markets reopened post-Diwali on Labh Panchami while diamond units halved their holiday break to fulfill improved orders.
Crude oil prices dropped 17% in 10 days, providing cost relief to the local MMF textile value chain.
Surat Position Printing Association implemented a 15% rate hike and mandated a strict 45-day bill payment window.
stress_signals: Textile printers enforced a 15% charge hike and a strict 45-day payment window, tightening receivables for buyers [ad48975ddfcf]
A massive fire destroyed a textile waste godown in Surat, requiring nine fire tenders to control [317f5c9fd10d]
improvement_signals: Crude oil prices declined 17% over 10 days, easing raw material cost pressures for MMF textiles [71350aa24679]
Diamond processing units reduced Diwali holidays due to improved order inflow [5fc0b7b85616]
Textile markets resumed normal trading activities following Labh Panchami [21ba34330cb5]
what_to_watch: Account-level working capital compliance with the mandatory 45-day printing payment terms.
Implementation timelines and compliance requirements for the Ministry of Textiles' fabric capacity database drive.
Sustainability project developments involving MANTRA and IIT Madras for long-term R&D impact.
